info.title: SQL Sentinel
info.description: Executable backend contract. Per-operation error codes and conditional optional features are documented in backend release/expansion documents. Integers representing nano-CNY are <=2^52. TLS verification required. No automatic client retry of billable requests.

servers.description: isolated local acceptance; configure verified HTTPS for production

execution_mode.description: Optional explicit observation-driven Agent mode. Omit for the unchanged fixed flow. Only automatic index proposals; no manual candidate, rewrite or benchmark in Agent mode.

sql.description: Existing admitted SQL; byte limit 64 KiB; no business SQL generation.
